load_count_df: load count data from an unprocessed CSV file and return a DataFrame with parsed mutations and counts
load_ngs_counts_from_paths: load unprocessed NGS count data from multiple experiment CSV files into a single merged DataFrame
get_enrichment_factor_df: compute enrichment factors for nucleic acid or amino acid variants from input and post-sort count columns
get_synonym_df: get enrichment factors for synonymous variants from a merged count DataFrame
get_stop_codon_df: get enrichment factors for variants that introduce stop codons from a merged count DataFrame
